**ProCalc on Android, and a proper icon.**

- **Android.** Install `ProCalc_0.4.0_android.apk` on any phone with Android 7 or newer. The
  Paper, the unit circle and the geometry workspace all work by touch.
- **Updates on your phone.** When a new version comes out, ProCalc tells you and downloads it;
  open the file to install it over the old one. Everything you made is kept.
- **Fits a phone screen.** The header and toolbars wrap, DEG/RAD and digits move into
  Settings, and nothing hides under the status bar.
- **A ProCalc icon** on the desktop, the taskbar and your home screen, instead of the default
  one.
- The ⓘ tips button now shows on Linux systems whose fonts lack that symbol.
